cm_open6.text: Make me any friend you like, with six parts in all!

cm_open10.text: Make me any friend you like, with ten parts in all!

cm_open15.text: Make me any friend you like, with fifteen parts in all!

cm_yes.text: Yes! Just how I wanted it!

cm_not.text: Hmm. Let's count all its parts.

rg_intro.text: Roll a giant! Every fact you know adds clay.

rg_make.text: Now make it a giant! Poke in eyes, and pull out arms!

rg_best.text: A new best! It gets a crown!

rg_welcome.text: Every giant is welcome in the row!

pq_intro.text: Let's have a parade! Stretch the mat to make the rows.

pq_m3x4.text: Three rows of four make twelve!

pq_m2x5.text: Two rows of five make ten!

pq_m4x4.text: Four rows of four make sixteen!

pq_m6x7.text: Six rows of seven make forty-two!

pq_m6x8.text: Six rows of eight make forty-eight!

pq_m7x8.text: Seven rows of eight make fifty-six!

pq_swapped.text: Nearly! Count the rows again. Turn it round!

pq_turn.text: Now turn it round! Twist the block, or press the turn button.

pq_15.text: Fifteen critters! Make a block with no gaps.

pq_block.text: A block with no gaps! Well done!

pq_every12.text: Find every way to march twelve!

pq_every18.text: Find every way to march eighteen! A block turned round counts once.

pq_another.text: Another way! Can you find more?

pq_left.text: Some critters have no place. Try another row size?

pq_13.text: Thirteen critters! Can they march in a block?

pq_13yes.text: Thirteen only marches in one long line!

pq_prime.text: A number like that is called a prime number.

pq_split.text: Swipe down the block to split it in two!

pq_splitdone.text: Two blocks, and still the same critters!

sp_intro.text: Squish Pairs! Drag one ball onto another.

sp_100.text: Squish two that make one hundred!

sp_not.text: Not those two. Try another pair!

sp_hint.text: Which ball goes with this one?

pr_tip.text: Hmm, not quite. Have another look!

pr_quick.text: Now the quick ones! As fast as you can!

vp_intro.text: Let's wake up the volcano! Every right answer makes it rumble.

vp_dots.text: No hurry! Look at the dots.

vp_best.text: A new best! Look how high!

kc_intro.text: Race you! Every right answer is a boost!

kc_dots.text: No hurry! Look at the dots, then type.

kc_time.text: Time's up! Let's look at the board.

kc_win.text: You won! That was a great race!

kc_lose.text: That was close! Shall we race again?

kc_calm.text: We made it! What a race!

kc_jump.text: Three in a row! A big jump!

bt_intro.text: Welcome to my bakery! Everything has to come out on time.

bt_set.text: Into the oven! Set the clock for when it comes out.

bt_late.text: Oh no, burnt! That's too late.

bt_read.text: When is it ready? Read the clock.

bt_tip_steps.text: Hmm. What do we need before that?

bt_day_or_night.text: Look out of the window. Is it day or night?

bt_tip_window.text: Look at the window. What's in the sky?

bt_which_part.text: What part of the day is it?

bt_part_sleep.text: When do we go to sleep?

bt_part_order.text: Morning, afternoon, night. Tap them in order!

bt_after_day.text: Which day comes after this one?

bt_before_day.text: Which day comes before this one?

bt_how_many_days.text: How many days in a week?

bt_today_is.text: Here's today. And yesterday we baked this.

bt_tip_today.text: Yesterday is just before today. Tomorrow is just after.

bt_month_after.text: Which month comes after this one?

bt_how_many_months.text: How many months in a year?

bt_one_week.text: We bake this every week. One week later, which day is it?

bt_tip_cal.text: A week has seven days. Each row is one week.

bt_which_thing.text: Which one happens at this time?

bt_am_is.text: a.m. is the morning, before noon.

bt_pm_is.text: p.m. is after noon, until night.

bt_tip_ampm.text: Morning is a.m. After noon is p.m.

bt_end.text: Everything baked on time! Thank you!
